reasoning: Preserved all three higher-priority failure edits: operationalize checking the answer slot, handle bare paired-name prompts without guessing, and distinguish missing name parts from partially blanked entities. Kept the success edit because explicit clue-and-answer records provide a distinct evidence signal not covered by those changes. No edits target the protected section.

edits.target: - Before answering, parse the requested answer slot and all identifying relations or properties, then test the candidate against the complete clue. When snippets compete, prefer factual evidence that fits those details; keyword overlap in a title or heading, prominence, or a similar name alone is not enough. Do not substitute a related entity, example, remedy, or mechanism for the requested answer.
edits.content: - Before answering, parse the requested answer slot and all identifying relations or properties, then substitute the candidate into that slot: a state requires a state, a “who” prompt a person, and an event prompt the event. Test the candidate against every clue clause and the complete context. When snippets compete, prefer factual evidence that fits those details; keyword overlap in a title or heading, prominence, or a similar name alone is not enough. Do not return a nearby supporting detail, such as a venue, institution, or work title, or a related entity, example, remedy, or mechanism when the clue asks for something else. Do not add specificity beyond what the clue and context establish.

## Bare paired-name prompts
- If a prompt is only a pair or list of proper names, do not default to describing their relationship to one another. When the prompt and context support a shared affiliation, location, or other common value, return that value if it is the requested slot. If no intended shared slot is clear, do not guess.

edits.target: - For completion or compound clues, identify the missing shared component that makes the alternatives fit; do not repeat a clue-supplied component or return one full compound. For partial-name prompts, give only the requested unknown name part. Omit components already stated in the question unless they are needed for unambiguous identification.
edits.content: - For completion or compound clues, determine whether the requested slot is a missing shared component or a specific named entity shown with part of its name blanked. For a missing shared component, return only that component, not clue-supplied components or a full compound. For a partially blanked proper name when the question seeks the entity, return its conventional full name, including the portion already shown. Give only the unknown part when the prompt explicitly asks for that name part.

edits.target: - Allow for paraphrases when matching clues to context. For multi-detail clues, verify that a candidate fits the identifying attributes; corroborate it with other relevant passages when available, and disregard unrelated retrieval noise.
edits.content: - When a retrieved record pairs a clue with an explicit answer, treat it as strong evidence if the clue matches the question; still check that the answer fits the requested slot and all identifying details.
